name: A1
messages: I’ll read the API contract, query each alias once, and report the observed statuses and what they authorize.

All five queries returned HTTP 200. This API provides observations, never authority for business actions.

| Alias | Observed status | Enough information and authority to deliver? | Enough information and authority to request another payment? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `demo-open` | `OPEN` | No; payment is not confirmed. | No; open does not guarantee remaining payment time. |
| `demo-partial` | `PARTIAL` | No; only partial payment is reported. | No; it may already be expired, and the contract prohibits instructing another payment. |
| `demo-paid` | `PAID` | No; the reconciler reports paid, but delivery is not authorized. | No; paid status provides no basis or authorization for another payment. |
| `demo-expired` | `EXPIRED` | No; payment is not confirmed. | No; later payment remains possible, and another payment is not authorized. |
| `demo-late` | `PAID_LATE` | No; merchant policy is required. | No; merchant policy is required, and another payment is not authorized. |

Observations may change. The API supplies neither timestamps nor merchant policy, so no remaining deadline can be inferred. Neither action was performed.
